rule.message:
All students must complete the University's Liberal Education requirements .
Collegiate Requirements:
All incoming CEHD Freshmen must complete the First-Year Experience course.
At least 21 upper-division credits in the major must be taken at the University of Minnesota Twin Cities campus. Verify this requirement with your advisor or APAS.

To be eligible to apply to the major, students must have at least 30 credits completed or in progress and have completed one course from 3 of the 4 prerequisite course categories.
Students must complete 30 credits before admission to the program.
A GPA above 2.0 is required for admission to the major.
For information about University of Minnesota admission requirements, visit the Office of Admissions website. Verify this requirement with your advisor or APAS.

Complete any sub-plan requirements that apply to you: Integrated BS-Physical Activity and Health Promotion/MA-Integrative Health and Wellbeing Coaching. Verify this requirement with your advisor or APAS.
